senses.gloss: क्रौञ्च, अस्, m. a curlew, heron, &c. See s. v.

क्रौञ्च क्रौञ्च, अस्, m. (fr. rt. क्रुञ्च्, q. v.),
a kind of curlew or heron (Ardea Jaculator); the
emblem of the fifth Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī;
(ई), f. the female curlew; a daughter of Tāmrā and
mother of the curlews; (अस्), m. a mountain, part of
the Himālaya range, situated in the eastern part of the
chain on the north of Asam; one of the Dvīpas or
principal divisions of the world, surrounded by the
sea of curds; N. of a Rakṣas; N. of a pupil of
Śāka-pūrṇi; (अम्), n., scil. अस्त्र, N. of a mystical
weapon; N. of a Sāman; also of a particular Vedic
formula.
—क्रौञ्च-दारण or क्रौञ्च-सूदन,
[]
अस्, m. an epithet of the god of war, Kārttikeya, who
tore asunder the mountain Krauñca.
—क्रौञ्च-
द्वीप, अस्, m., N. of a Dvīpa, = क्रौञ्च.
—क्रौञ्च-
पक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, an epithet of horses, ‘the flanks
of which are similar to the wings of a curlew.’
—क्रौञ्च-पदा, f., N. of a metre consisting of
four lines of twenty-five syllables each.
—क्रौञ्च-
पदी, f., N. of a place.
—क्रौञ्च-पुर, अस्, m.,
N. of a town.
—क्रौञ्च-बन्ध, अस्, m. a parti-
cular kind of knot.
—क्रौञ्च-रन्ध्र, अम्, n. the
Krauñca pass, caused by the deity Kārttikeya and by
Paraśu-rāma; see क्रौञ्चारि below.
—क्रौञ्च-वत्,
आन्, m., N. of a mountain, = क्रौञ्च.
—क्रौञ्चा-
दन (˚च-अद्˚), अम्, n. the fibres of the stalk of the
lotus (मृणाल); N. of several plants, = घेञ्चुली;
another plant, = चिञ्चोटक; long pepper; (ई), f. the
seed of the lotus.
—क्रौञ्चारण्य (˚च-अर्˚), अम्, n.,
N. of a forest.
—क्रौञ्चाराति (˚च-अर्˚), इस्, m. an
epithet of the deity Kārttikeya.
—क्रौञ्चारि (˚च-
अरि), इस्, m. an epithet of the deity Kārttikeya and
of the hero and Avatāra Paraśu-rāma, who with his
arrows made a pass or defile through the Krauñca
mountain.
क्रौड, अस्, ई, अम्, fit for or belonging to a hog.
क्रौड क्रौड. See under क्रोड last col.
क्रौञ्चिकी-पुत्र, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.

क्रौर्य क्रौर्य, अम्, n. (fr. क्रूर), cruelty,
fierceness, anger; hard-heartedness; terribleness.

क्रौशशतिक क्रौशशतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. क्रोश
+ शत), one who goes a hundred Krośas or leagues;
one who deserves to be approached from a distance of a
hundred Krośas or leagues (as a religious teacher &c.).

क्रौष्टिक क्रौष्टिक, अस्, m. a wrong form for
क्रौष्टुकि, q. v.

क्रौष्टुकर्ण क्रौष्टुकर्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, coming
from Kroṣṭu-karṇa.

क्रौष्टुकि क्रौष्टुकि, इस्, m. (a patronymic
fr. क्रोष्टुक), N. of a grammarian; N. of an
astrologer; N. of a warrior-tribe belonging to the
Trigarta-ṣaṣṭhās.

क्रौष्टुकीय, अस्, m. a prince of the warrior-
tribe called Krauṣṭuki.
